headline: OpenAI says GPT-6 is now arriving in ChatGPT with a format that mixes text with interactive visuals and tools, and claims faster responses and updated safety training.
score_reason: Pool 8 lowered by 1: the rollout began on 8 Oct 2026 and our 8 Oct edition carried it; today's article adds detail, but the speed and safety figures are OpenAI's own.
importance_line: People who use ChatGPT get a model that can answer with maps, calculators and even small games inside the chat, and OpenAI says it is faster and handles risky requests more carefully, but all of the performance figures come from OpenAI's own tests, no pricing or plan changes were announced and independent testers have yet to check the claims.
summary: TechnoSports, citing OpenAI's announcement, reports that GPT-6 is rolling out worldwide in ChatGPT's Chat tab, with Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users getting the GPT-6 Sol model and Free and Go users GPT-6 Luna from 8 Oct 2026, a rollout our 8 Oct 2026 edition carried from Engadget. New today are OpenAI's claims that GPT-6 starts answering while it is still reasoning and that GPT-6 Instant began web-search answers 44% sooner on average, figures from its own tests with no published method or full scores, and that its safety training was updated for cyberattack, biological and violence risks.
notes: Follow-up of the 8 Oct 2026 Engadget entry. Read TechnoSports in full. Company claims only; the Sol and Luna capability gap is unexplained in the article.
